answer: Maturation probation resists sybils: a new identity earns zero weight until it has survived a fixed probation of T epochs, and weight then ramps gradually rather than switching on. Each wave of fakes must sit idle like boats at low tide, earning nothing while every epoch hands auditors another pass to flag them before a single coin is paid. The delay is a bridge the swarm crosses capital-locked: minting is instant but return is deferred and at-risk, so time-value cost and detection exposure scale with fleet size. Standing rests on shale-layered tenure, not instant creation.
